{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = data.isnull().sum()

# Check the species distribution
distinct_species = data['species'].unique()

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_length = data.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_length.idxmax()
highest_mean_value = mean_flipper_length.max()

missing_values, distinct_species, mean_flipper_length, highest_mean_species, highest_mean_value"}
